known_reference_limits.ascent_masks: altitude145points/36five-secondbins; speed442points/96bins;11wrong-body altitude fields quarantined; no fills
known_reference_limits.booster_comparisons: previously seen and subsequently used in design; not blind holdout or independent real-vehicle validation
known_reference_limits.contact_interval: 415..420s derives from rounded display and is report-only, not a physical acceptance gate
known_reference_limits.frame_clock: integer displayed seconds and unknown subsecond/filter alignment; display rounding is not sensor accuracy
known_reference_limits.parameter_count: this saved analysis fits zero parameters; it does not establish the number of parameters used to develop the current controller
known_reference_limits.physical_recovery: not established by these residuals; use separately pinned original native verifier
known_reference_limits.ship_reentry: not evaluated by this manifest; do not substitute historical-source residuals
known_reference_limits.source_class: processed OCR and rolling median except four individually reviewed manual speed replacements; not raw telemetry
known_reference_limits.speed_frame: surface relative working assumption, not independently confirmed at all times

purpose: Descriptive saved-only display audit. No new fit, baseline improvement, flight or qualification.

fit_data.coverage_rule: Complete0..491 coverage of both frozen masks is required for scoring. A valid physical failure before completing this fit coverage is inadmissible and preserved; a later physical insertion failure is reported separately and does not remove an otherwise valid fit candidate. An unexplained numerical/serialization/coverage defect is invalid and stops the cohort.
fit_data.interpolation: Linear simulation interpolation at each observed elapsed time using finite bracketing samples no more than2.1 seconds apart; no extrapolation.
fit_data.missing_values: Use every frozen finite nonblank observation except the same eleven wrong-body altitude fields. Only four individually sourced manual speed observations differ from original processedOCR. No filling, extra smoothing, retiming, extrapolation or residual-dependent masks.
